l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Tell me ___. (Gaaffii jalqabaa: What size do they need?) Jechi kam iddoo duwwaa guuta?
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: "what" fi "size" adda baafameera. Jechi gaaffii fi maqaan kutaa tokko godhu.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: "do" hafeera, kanaaf tartiiba gaaffii kallattii dha. Gaaffii al-kallattii keessatti "do" ni dhabama.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Kutaan jecha gaaffii fuulduraatti hin jiru. Dura dhufuu qaba.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Jecha gaaffii + maqaan kutaa tokko ta'ee dura dhufa, mata-dureen + gochi isa booda. "do/does" ni dhabama.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Akka "what color," "which road," fi "whose bag," jechi gaaffii fi maqaan kutaa tokko ta'ee dura dhufa fi "do" ni dhabama, kanaaf "what size they need" sirrii dha.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Fakkeenya sadanuu keessatti, mata-dureen fi gochi jecha gaaffii + maqaa booda dhufu fi "do/does" ni dhabama, kanaaf "what size they need" filadhu.
